mode: fixed-origin recursive 12-month; no within-test actual updates
missingness: No missing actual zero filling. Prophet uses observed targets; SARIMAX native missing-state handling; RF past-only lag median fallback; naive unavailable when prior-year value missing. Score only shared observed actual and observed prior-year dates.
selection: Unweighted disease mean of region-fold MASE means on matched CV2022-2024 primary diseases; National and provisional datasets excluded from selection
case_policy: All source numeric counts/classifications retained; duplicate candidates not removed; Hep A one-row-one-case is provisional.
weekly_calendar: Declared legacy ISO Thursday; W53 folded to52; source verification unresolved for Dengue and provisional ILI

random_forest.lag_fallback_detail: Past-observed same-month median, otherwise past-observed overall median; zero only if no earlier observed history is available for an initial feature. Targets are never filled.

holdout_status: Retrospective 2025 evaluation; earlier project has inspected 2025 outcomes; no untouched-holdout claim
export_precision_note: Initial ARFF serialization rounded checkpoints. Full-precision export regenerated, all320 RF forecasts replayed identically; native WEKA errors match recorded metrics.
